{{Top}}
[[File:Meditation_TCG_by_BrianRood.jpg|thumb|240px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in his [[Darth Vader's meditation chamber/Legends|meditation chamber]].]]
A '''meditation chamber''', or '''Qabbrat''' in [[Sith (language)|Ancient Sith]], was a place where a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] or a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] could [[Meditation/Legends|meditate]] to enhance their powers with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].

==History==
[[Visas Marr]] was given use of a meditation chamber by [[Darth Nihilus]] aboard his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Ravager (Centurion-class)|''Ravager'']]. She had her final meditation there before killing her master, being the place where she finally felt the value of compassion. Also, [[Atris]] had a large meditation chamber in which she stored [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]]. [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Skere Kaan|Kaan]] used a spherical meditation chamber on board his flagship, [[Nightfall (Sith Destroyer)|''Nightfall'']], from which he directed the forces of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] using his powerful abilities of [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]]. [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] maintained a secret meditation chamber in the spire of the then [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center|Chancellor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] following the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

[[File:DookuMeditationChamber-DookuCaptured.png|thumb|left|250px|Count Dooku meditates in his private chambers aboard his personal frigate.]]
[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] maintained a meditation chamber aboard his [[Count Dooku's frigate/Legends|personal frigate]]. After [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] allowed himself to be captured and imprisoned aboard Dooku's frigate, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] rescued him and the two made their way to the Count's meditation chamber. There, they found Dooku sitting cross-legged and meditating on a round platform. When they moved to capture the Sith Lord, the floor beneath the platform gave way to an escape hatch.

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Darth Vader's meditation chamber/Legends|meditation chamber]] was a specially pressurized, black hyperbaric capsule where he could sit and breathe without requiring his [[Darth Vader's armor/Legends|body suit]]. A mechanical claw assembly removed his helmet, allowing him to breathe the hyper-[[Oxygen/Legends|oxygenated]] environment without his mask, which was otherwise necessary. One chamber, surrounded by diagnostic computers, was placed on his flagship, the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], and contained a [[HoloNet transceiver/Legends|hologram projection pod]] for communications with his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]]. Another, larger chamber was located in the [[Bast Castle]] on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]. It was within the privacy of these chambers that Vader could mourn his late wife [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], and where he hid his lamented reflections on his terrible past from [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. He also attempted to heal the injuries suffered on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] using the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energies focused within the chamber. However, while he did succeed to some degree, his progress was minimal at best as the joy he felt upon healing himself banished the dark side and returned his body to its scarred state, a puzzle the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] was unable to solve.
